title: Week 12 Saturday Recap: Top Lines + Upsets
parts:
🏈 SATURDAY RECAP | Wk 12

58 games final. Top prospect lines 👇

🎯 Trinidad Chambliss (Ole Miss): 19/20, 367 yds, 5 TD
🏃 Cole Tabb (Cincinnati): 23-120-2 rush, 7-110-2 rec
🙌 Reed Harris (ASU): 11 rec, 172 yds, 2 TD
🧱 Scott Moore (Delaware): 4 rec, 54 yds, 3 TD

🆕 FRESHMAN & SOPHOMORE WATCH

• Tristan Ti'a | Auburn QB | SO: 17/18, 341 yds, 4 TD +1 rush TD (45.2 pts)
• Jaylin Carter | Memphis RB | SO: 23 car, 229 yds, 3 TD (40.9 pts)
• Trace Johnson | Tulane QB | FR: 17/21, 283 yds, 4 TD, 1 INT (35.6 pts)

🚨 BREAKOUT FLAGS

• Travis Burgess (FR, UNC): 1st career 300-yd pass + 100-yd rush game
• Faizon Brandon (FR, Tennessee): 1st career 100-yd rush game
• Kenny Darby (FR, Kentucky): 1st career 100-yd rec game
• Bo MacCormack III (SO, BC): season-high 236 rush yds

🚨 SIX RANKED TEAMS WENT DOWN.

#4 UCLA, #8 Indiana, #14 Ohio State, #16 Kentucky, #17 Boise State and #21 South Carolina all lost on Saturday.

The upsets and the prospects who decided them 👇

😱 Michigan 18, #4 UCLA 16 (UM +3.5)
Savion Hiter: 26 car, 104 yds.

😱 Washington 27, #8 Indiana 24 (UW +9.5)
Demond Williams Jr. had 315 total yds and 2 TD. Charlie Becker's season-high 167 rec yds came in the loss.

😱 Nebraska 31, #14 Ohio State 28 (NU +3.5)
Anthony Colandrea: 200 pass yds, 3 TD + 63 rush yds, 1 TD. Jeremiah Smith had 6-165-2 in the loss.

Also: Missouri 28, #16 Kentucky 14. Austin Simmons threw for 314 and 4 TD.

🔥 Biggest spread upset: Rutgers 25, Penn State 24. Rutgers was a 24.5-pt underdog. Antwan Raymond: 101 rush yds, 2 TD.

🔥 G5: San Diego State 22, #17 Boise State 20 (SDSU +20.5).

Navy 38, Memphis 34: Jackson Gutierrez ran for 241 and 2 TD.

That's a wrap on Saturday. Which result shakes up your devy board most? 👇

P4 Performers of the Week at 1 PM ET.
